size.$description: Fixed control, icon and stroke sizes, aligned to shadcn's control heights (h-8 / h-9 / h-10) and its size-4 icon default. The switch, checkbox and selection-bar sizes v1 defined here are gone: those components come from the library now, and a token nobody reads is a value that drifts.

icon-md.$description: shadcn's default icon size inside a control (`size-4`).

icon-lg.$description: Standalone glyph — empty-state plate, nav item.

ctl-h-md.$description: shadcn Button default (h-9). Also the search field.

sz-iconbtn.$description: Square icon button (shadcn `size-9`). 36px is above the 24px WCAG 2.2 target minimum and comfortable under a finger on Android.

sz-badge-dot.$description: Smaller dot inside a badge or status line.

focus-ring-width.$description: shadcn's focus ring is a 3px accent halo at 50% alpha plus a 1px border shift. The ring is never removed, only restyled (A11Y contract).
